about: The performance budgets CI fails on. A budget is an alarm, not a target: it sits at the size measured when it was set plus a stated headroom, with the measured number beside it. Raise one only with a measured reason in the pull request (docs/GITFLOW.md section 1). tests/unit/perf-budget.test.mjs rejects a budget that is not exactly its measured value plus the rule, so a looser number cannot be typed in. bundle is rewritten by node scripts/perf-budget.mjs --write; firstLoad and cls by UPDATE_PERF_BUDGETS=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/perf-budget.spec.js (one --project at a time, --workers=1).

bundle.about: gzip level 9, Node zlib, each file on its own, from dist/.vite/manifest.json (npm run perf:budget). A route is its manifest entries (a key, or a chunk name) with their static imports and CSS; `after` leaves out what that route already loaded, so a lazy view counts what opening it adds to a visit that has the first load.

firstLoad.label: First load: index.html's entry chunk, its static imports and their CSS

home.label: Home view, opened after the first load

exam.label: Practice and exam view, opened after the first load

results.label: Results view, opened after the first load

wikiIndex.label: VetWiki index (/wiki), opened after the first load: the view alone

wikiArticle.label: VetWiki article (/wiki/com5/rabies), opened after the first load: the view and what an article loads with it (the adapter, the subject's text, the conflict note)

firstLoad.about: Home on a first visit, Chromium, median of 3 fresh contexts, any request to another host aborted (it still counts as a request). Requests: all http(s) requests started until the app has made its online check and the network has gone quiet. Image bytes: same-origin image responses. A mobile visit sometimes makes 135 requests and 1,452,170 image bytes (27,550 fewer), and does in every run with the CPU slowed 4x; the median and the 3% headroom absorb it. tests/e2e/perf-budget.spec.js.

cls.about: Layout shift (Layout Instability API, shifts within 500 ms of a tap or key left out), median of 3 first visits. The budget is the limit, 0.01; a page that is not under it yet is budgeted at its measured value instead, and AGENTS.md lists the gap as work to do (none is, on the day these were written). tests/e2e/perf-budget.spec.js.
